reason: Maa appears only inside the standard Estonian technical category name Maa-tüüpi planeedid. This describes a planetary class; it does not supply which planet has extensive oceans. Retain the valid term rather than remove a scientifically correct translation.
The apparent S wave is the possessive ending of instrument’s followed by wave amplitude. It does not name an S-wave or reveal the transverse-wave response.

Kui is the ordinary Estonian comparative conjunction meaning as in presidendi kui kapteni (the president as captain). That grammar does not name, cite or otherwise disclose Kipling's poem Kui…; preserving the translation is necessary.
